actions.name: create_company

anyOf.description: The Linear customer tier ID, or null to clear it. Use the official linear-options endpoint through proxy to discover valid IDs.

anyOf.description: The Linear user ID of the company owner, or null to clear it. Use the official linear-options endpoint through proxy to discover valid IDs.

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Create a contact in the connected Productlane workspace.

anyOf.description: The contact avatar URL. Omit it to let Productlane resolve Gravatar.

image_url.description: The contact avatar URL. Omit it to let Productlane resolve Gravatar.

is_subscribed.description: Whether the contact receives changelog and project or issue update emails. Productlane defaults this to true.

company_id.description: The Productlane company ID to associate. Mutually exclusive with company_name and company_external_id.

company_name.description: An exact company name to resolve. Mutually exclusive with company_id and company_external_id.

company_external_id.description: An external company ID to resolve. Mutually exclusive with company_id and company_name.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for creating a Productlane contact.

anyOf.description: The contact name.
The contact avatar URL.
The Productlane company ID associated with the contact.

company_id.description: The Productlane company ID associated with the contact.

is_subscribed.description: Whether the contact receives changelog and project or issue update emails.

slack_channel.description: The Slack channel ID associated with the contact.

external_ids.description: External service IDs associated with the Productlane contact.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the contact was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the contact was last updated.

actions.name: delete_company

inputSchema.description: Request parameters identifying a Productlane company.

id.description: The ID of the deleted Productlane resource.

id.description: The ID of the deleted Productlane resource.

actions.name: get_authenticated_identity
actions.description: Get the authenticated Productlane API key identity, granted scopes, and Linear team selection.

inputSchema.description: This Productlane action does not require any input.

workspace_id.description: The Productlane workspace ID associated with the API key.

api_key_id.description: The unique ID of the Productlane API key.

scopes.description: The scopes granted to the Productlane API key.

linear_team_ids.description: The Linear team IDs selected for this workspace.

anyOf.description: The default Linear team ID, or null when no default is configured.

default_linear_team_id.description: The default Linear team ID, or null when no default is configured.

outputSchema.description: The authenticated Productlane API key identity.
